intro: Game-ready assets made for Roblox. Pay with PayPal or Robux and get the files right after.
paypalSteps: Click “Buy with PayPal” and pay on the checkout page.
You get a download link on screen and by email.
Download the .zip and import it into Studio.
robuxSteps: Click “Buy with Robux” to open the store hub on Roblox.
Buy the pack in the hub.
The files are sent to you on Discord.

faq.q: Can I use the assets in a game that makes money?
faq.a: Yes. You can use them in any Roblox game, paid or free. You can't resell or share the files themselves.
Every pack has .fbx and .blend files. Packs marked with a Roblox model file are ready to drop into Studio.

faq.q: I paid but didn't get my files.
faq.a: Check your spam folder first. If it's not there, message me on Discord with your order email or Roblox username and I'll sort it out.
Because the files are delivered right away, sales are final. If a file is broken, I'll fix it or refund you.
